summary: Tested endgame lesson system for chess coaching app. All 22 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests verified: Study page tabs, Endgames tab with 3 categories and 10 lessons, interactive lesson page with correct/wrong move feedback, Home page Study card updated to 'Openings & Endgames'.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend endgame_theory_service.py correctly loads and serves endgame lessons from JSON
check_move function properly validates UCI moves and returns appropriate feedback
Frontend EndgameLesson.jsx implements Position → Try → Teach flow correctly
LichessBoard component properly handles movableColor prop for endgame positions
OpeningsOverview.jsx correctly implements Openings | Endgames tabs with URL parameter support
HomePage.jsx Study card updated to show 'Openings & Endgames'
seed_data_creation: None - used existing endgame_theory_tree.json with 30 positions across 10 lessons
context_for_next_testing_agent: Endgame lesson system fully tested. Backend APIs: GET /api/endgames/categories (3 categories, 10 lessons), GET /api/endgames/lesson/{cat}/{lesson} (returns positions without answers), POST /api/endgames/check-move (validates moves). Frontend: Study page at /openings-overview with Openings|Endgames tabs, interactive lesson at /endgames/{category}/{lesson}. Chessground board requires click-click to make moves (select piece, then click destination). Board coordinates: file index 0-7 (a-h), rank from top = 8 - rank_from_bottom.

GET /api/endgames/categories.returns: 3 categories (king_and_pawn, rook_endgames, queen_vs_pawn) with 10 total lessons

GET /api/endgames/lesson/{cat}/{lesson}.returns: Lesson with positions (FEN, prompt, side_to_move) - no answers exposed

POST /api/endgames/check-move.correct_move: Returns correct=true, move_san, on_correct, idea, rule_reminder, is_last
POST /api/endgames/check-move.wrong_move: Returns correct=false, correct_move_san, on_wrong, idea, rule_reminder, is_last

interactive_lesson.correct_feedback: Green checkmark, explanation, rule, Next Position button
interactive_lesson.wrong_feedback: Red X, correct answer shown, explanation, idea, rule, Try Again and Next buttons

home_page_study_card.text: Openings & Endgames - Your repertoire + endgame lessons
